Old Delhi food tasting tour with Chandni Chowk

Chandni Chowk · 4 hours

4 hours New Delhi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Four hours and roughly eight stops through the lanes of Chandni Chowk, eating at shops that have been doing one dish for a century.

At a glance

Duration
About 4 hours
Food
8 to 10 tastings, enough for a meal
Transport
Private AC car plus walking and rickshaw
Tour type
Private
Guide
Local food guide
Best time
Late afternoon into the evening

What makes this one worth it

  • Chaat, stuffed parathas, sweets and savoury snacks at stalls your guide trusts
  • A rickshaw through the narrowest lanes of Chandni Chowk
  • Jama Masjid and the spice, dry fruit, silver and attar markets
  • Red Fort and India Gate photo stops
  • Vegetarian versions arranged on request

Your tour schedule

  1. 10 AM – 3 PM

    Pickup at a time that suits you

    Pickup from your hotel or chosen address in Delhi NCR, and into Old Delhi.

  2. First hour

    Jama Masjid

    A short guided visit to the great mosque of Shah Jahan and its history.

  3. By rickshaw

    Chandni Chowk

    A rickshaw ride through the bazaars and heritage lanes.

  4. On foot

    The old markets

    Spice, dry fruit, silver jewellery, attar and fabric markets, with the Khari Baoli spice lanes at the centre.

  5. Tasting stops

    Street food

    Chaat, stuffed parathas, Indian sweets and savoury snacks at stalls chosen for hygiene and popularity, with your guide on how each one is made.

  6. To finish

    Red Fort, India Gate and Parliament

    A photo stop outside the Red Fort, India Gate, and a drive past Parliament House before drop-off.

What the price covers

  • All food tastings on the route
  • Local food guide
  • Rickshaw ride
  • Private AC car for pickup and drop
  • Bottled water

What it does not cover

  • Alcohol
  • Extra portions beyond the tasting route
  • Tips

Questions people ask

Is this a private food tour in Old Delhi?
Yes. It is a private, guided food walk with your own AC car for transfers and a dedicated local guide, with pickup from hotels or the airport in Delhi NCR.
What type of food is included during the tour?
You will taste a mix of Old Delhi favourites, from crispy street snacks and chaat to traditional sweets and local dishes. Let us know about any allergies or dietary needs before the day.
Is the rickshaw ride included in the tour?
Yes, a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk is included and is a fun way to move between food stops.
Are monument entry tickets included?
No, entry tickets for any monuments are not part of this tour; if you want to visit one, you pay at the gate.
Is this tour suitable for vegetarians?
Yes, very much so. Old Delhi has a huge range of vegetarian food, and we can make the whole tour vegetarian if you prefer.
Is the food safe for tourists?
Your guide takes you only to clean, popular and well-known stalls that locals and visitors trust, and you can always try a smaller portion if you are unsure.
